players.product: HDD suspensions (Disk Drive Suspension business) for high-capacity HDDs used in AI-related applications and data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half April-September 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 393,930 million (+0.7%), operating income JPY 18,534 million (-19.2%), ordinary income JPY 19,833 million (-26.5%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 13,906 million (-35.5%). Segments (sales / operating income): suspension springs JPY 83,014 million (-0.6%) / JPY 300 million (prior-year first half: operating loss JPY 652 million); seats JPY 142,003 million (-5.9%) / JPY 2,028 million (-63.1%); precision parts JPY 50,812 million (+2.0%) / JPY 1,312 million (-23.2%) - HDD mechanism-part volumes rose on data-center high-capacity HDD demand; industrial machinery and others JPY 58,060 million (+5.6%) / JPY 2,828 million (-25.2%) - semiconductor process parts demand kept increasing, offset by depreciation on capex for future demand. H1 R&D JPY 12,256 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 393,930 million (+0.7%); operating income JPY 18,534 million (-19.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: DDS (Disk Drive Suspension) segment, first half April-September 2025 (semi-annual report): sales JPY 60,040 million (+15.5%) and operating income JPY 12,063 million (-4.4%); demand for data-center high-capacity HDDs increased and HDD suspension volumes rose year on year, but fixed costs and FX weighed. Management states world HDD production fell year on year, yet more high-capacity HDDs for data centers lifted total demand for its suspensions.
quarterly_data.figure: DDS H1 sales JPY 60,040 million (+15.5%); operating income JPY 12,063 million (-4.4%)
